source: Microsoft WinDbg built-in MCP, existing VMware serial kernel session; direct register, memory, process and WDF queue observations.

environment.controller: Operator-prepared PS3 USB controller in DsHidMini XInput mode; reconnected after sleep

reuse.conclusion: A subsequent queued-state request by the same GameInput process selected the corrected node and loaded its existing WDF queue handle instead of taking the allocation branch.

end_state.target: LiveKernel AMD64, stopped at driver RVA 0x91ee

limitations: This is a one-entry live data correction and one observed queue reuse, not a driver-code patch or installable fix.
The corrected field remains in the current device lifetime; no claim is made about later teardown or reconnect.
Zero queue requests were observed before the current request was forwarded; this does not characterize completion timing or rates.
Allocation growth, cleanup latency, CPU, FPS/frame time, input fidelity/latency, vibration and recovery were not measured.
Existing excess queues remain, preventing an interpretation as a clean corrected performance baseline.
Guest inbox revision differs from the contributor's 0.2309.19041.6456; FPS causation and a general workaround remain unproven.
Breakpoint pauses introduce observer overhead; no elapsed-time or throughput claim is derived from this experiment.
The wait_for_break tool was advertised by the proxy but unavailable on the connected server; explicit target-state queries confirmed stops before inspection.
